description: Country for the analysis unit. All rows are India.
Indian state for the analysis unit. All rows are Tamil Nadu.
Level of observation used for the analysis. In this file, each row is a district.
Cleaned/current Tamil Nadu district name used as the district-level analysis unit.
Approximate latitude of the district center or main district town, in decimal degrees.
Approximate longitude of the district center or main district town, in decimal degrees.
Coordinate reference system for district_lat and district_lon. Coordinates use WGS84 / EPSG:4326.
Indicator equal to 1 if the district contains at least one operational SEZ from the Tamil Nadu SEZ dataset, and 0 otherwise.
Number of operational SEZs from zones.csv located in the district.
Haversine distance in kilometers from the approximate district center to Chennai, Tamil Nadu's main economic and administrative center.
Indicator equal to 1 if the district has direct coastline access, and 0 otherwise.

Population density of the district, measured as persons per square kilometer. Values are based on Census 2011 district-level population density where available; newer post-2011 districts use approximate/harmonized values.
Reference year for the population density variable. Most values are based on 2011 Census data.
Source note for the population density value, including whether the value is direct Census 2011 district data or an approximate/harmonized value for newer districts.
Description of how distance_to_chennai_km was calculated.
2011 Census state identifier used to merge SHRUG VIIRS night lights.
2011 Census district identifier used to merge SHRUG VIIRS night lights.
Name of the 2011 Census district used by the night lights crosswalk.
Note explaining whether a current district directly matched a 2011 district or was mapped to a parent 2011 district.
Year of the SHRUG VIIRS night lights measure used in analysis_units.csv.
SHRUG VIIRS category used; average-masked is used here.
Mean VIIRS night lights detected within the 2011 district polygon.
Total VIIRS night lights detected within the 2011 district polygon.
Number of raster cells used to calculate district-level VIIRS night lights.
